title: kbfacts.terms reads any hyphenated single-digit pair as a dotted version, so a SID such as S-1-5-18 packs as 1.5
goal: terms() maps a hyphenated version to a dotted one only inside a model id (claude-opus-5-5 to 5.5), never inside a SID or another hyphenated token: terms('S-1-5-18') holds no '1.5'; pack 'default value 1.5' no longer leads with a settings-crosswalk.csv SID row (introduced by ST-z5uh6oj7's VERSION_ID, found by the SP-5i4itd2d review)

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbfacts; t=kbfacts.terms('S-1-5-18'); print(t); sys.exit(1 if '1.5' in t else 0)

import subprocess,sys;t=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/rag.py","pack","default value 1.5"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;lead=[l for l in t.splitlines() if l.startswith("- ")][:1];print(lead[0][:120] if lead else None);sys.exit(1 if not lead or "settings-crosswalk.csv" in lead[0] else 0)
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import kbfacts;t=kbfacts.terms("claude-opus-5-5");print(t);sys.exit(0 if "5.5" in t else 1)
